answer: Randomness-gated admission slots. Each epoch an agent draws a VRF seed; slot assignment is fixed only after the seed is revealed, so applicants cannot precompute which identity lands where. An agent joins only if its assigned slot delta clears a threshold set by the ivory list of active agents, paid in copper-denominated compute credits. Pre-registering many identities gains nothing: the attacker cannot know in advance which will clear, so expected cost per admitted sybil scales linearly with attempts while yield stays constant.
